data.one_liner: Flutter extension for the logging package providing formatting, console logging, and an in-app log console.
data.what_it_does: It provides a simple tool for logging messages with severity levels, printing class and method names, capturing third-party package logs, and viewing logs inside an in-app console.
use_when: You want a structured logging format in your Flutter app using the standard logging package
You need an in-app console widget to view and share logs on device
You want to forward logs to third-party services like Crashlytics or DataDog
avoid_when: You are building a pure Dart package without Flutter dependencies
You require complex distributed tracing solutions
strengths: Supports custom formatters and multiple logger names
Easy integration with external logging and crash reporting services
weaknesses: Limited to Flutter applications due to its extension nature and UI components
Basic log filtering requires manual implementation
data.setup_notes: Initialize Flogger using Flogger.init() and optionally register listeners.
